UNDER-CREDITING IS NOT THE SAFE DIRECTION FOR A GATE THAT PRICES A DELTA. claim.law.T18_a-gate-that-nets-matched-data-per-byte-cannot-see-an-all-or-nothing-section-loss.20260903.v1 measured that defake_gate's per-byte data accounting OVER-credits on 91 units, named an 18-unit class where it UNDER-credits instead (objdiff credits data at SYMBOL granularity and RESOLVES RELOCATIONS, while the gate compares raw bytes), and concluded 'A gate must under-credit rather than manufacture a pass'. That conclusion is correct for a verdict on an ABSOLUTE state and WRONG for a delta, which is what `check` actually reports: an under-credited BASELINE manufactures a phantom GAIN the moment a lane repairs the raw bytes, and the gate then instructs the lane to bank a loss. This is the same failure T18 describes, relocated from the verdict to the baseline, and it is the direction T18 called safe.

MEASURED END TO END on game/mb/mb_tree at c8a28c3bb, one section, both accountings, both directions:
  HEAD, image        report.json main/game/mb/mb_tree matched_data=432 total_data=432 (100%)
                     PROGRESS `Data: 178856 / 2361748 bytes (7.57%)`
  HEAD, gate         `defake_gate.py baseline game/mb/mb_tree --at-head` prints
                     `DATA baseline: 380/432 matched bytes; .rodata 0/52` - the gate scores
                     the SAME section 0/52 that the image scores 52/52
  the edit           name the anonymous pool literal: `const char lbl_801160D4[16] = "Too many nodes";`
                     plus both `FatalError(lbl_801160D4, 0x804000);` call sites
  gate verdict       `DATA-CHANGED __sections__ matched DATA bytes: .rodata 0->52 of 52 (+52 B).
                     NET +52 B of matched Data gained`, two `RELOC-TOWARD-TARGET` rows reading
                     `this is a relocation REPAIR, not a regression; keep it and re-anchor with
                     --update-improved`, and `GATE OK (2 improved)`
  image verdict      full ninja, `main.dol: OK`, PROGRESS `Data: 178804` and report.json
                     matched_data=380 - a LOSS of 52 bytes
  restored           full ninja at HEAD returns Data 178856 and matched_data=432
The gate reported +52 on a change the project metric scores -52: not an overstatement, a SIGN INVERSION, and it shipped with an explicit instruction to bank it.

WHY THE RELOCATION HALF DOES NOT RESCUE IT. Both `RELOC-TOWARD-TARGET` rows are individually TRUE - our new `lbl_801160D4` really does match target reloc[9] and reloc[10] in MBNewNode and reloc[7]/reloc[8] in MBCreateNode, exactly as claim.law.PR_defake-gate-compares-relocation-names-while-fndiff-relocs-resolves-them.20260903.v1 describes. A true relocation repair and a data regression are independent, and the gate summed them into one `GATE OK (2 improved)`. Per-function .text verdicts cannot see data at all, so nothing else in the loop contradicted it.

THE RULE FOR LANES, until the gate is fixed: a keep that adds, renames or resizes ANY data symbol is arbitrated on a full `ninja` PROGRESS `Data:` line before and after, never on defake_gate's DATA-CHANGED row. The two-build cost is the price of the only accounting the project reports. THE RULE FOR THE TOOL: price the baseline in the measure's own units, or refuse to print a data delta at all - a delta between two accountings is not a measurement of anything.
